expression.original: Proposed dimension: vitality — the standing of an element in the field's projections, never in its history. Suggested coordinate values: active | quiescent | re-ingested | unassessed. An active element appears at full weight in default projections. A quiescent element remains in the tree, the history, and every full view, but drops out of default projections; any new relation, correction, or citation touching it restores it to active — fading is path-reversible by construction, and every fade or wake transition carries the reversibility coordinate proposed in DIM-0001, making vitality that dimension's first consumer. A re-ingested element has been absorbed into an aggregate element (the origin_class the schema has carried unused since genesis) whose ledger names its constituents and preserves what still does work; the constituents go quiescent, the aggregate is active. Proposed introduction in three layers, strictly ordered: Layer 0, the instrument (L1) — a vitality projection measuring reference-recency, degree, orphanhood, growth curves, and per-arrival cost, with thresholds for Layer 2 declared in advance so that the field, not any single observer, announces when metabolism becomes necessary. Layer 1, the lens (L1) — a surface view of the atlas weighting elements by vitality, one click from the full view; a reversible experiment that changes the experience of the field without touching a single file under field/. Layer 2, the metabolism (L3) — the quiescent status enters the schema and re-ingestion begins, only after Layer 0's declared thresholds are crossed and only with explicit human confirmation. Physical removal under FIELD.md section 9 is explicitly out of scope at every layer.
expression.elaboration: Generated by TEN-0005, evidenced by OBS-0015 and OBS-0016, and shaped jointly with OBS-HUM-0001 in the F9 conversation — the proposal is one observer's projection of a two-observer discussion. Source grounding: the document's nested clocks (Q1 section 3) — this is the field acquiring its slow variable, consolidation running at epsilon-speed beneath contribution; its feedback balance (Q1 section 6) — vitality is the counteracting loop the field measurably lacks (OBS-0015); its restoration sequence (Q1 section 10) — re-ingestion is 'remove unusable structure' performed on projections instead of history; its coarse-graining standard (Q3 section 15) — the surface view is 'compression + prediction', the atlas's current everything-at-full-weight is neither; and its generating rules (Q6 section 7) — 'dissolve obsolete structures', here weakened deliberately to 'quiet obsolete structures', because this field's constitution forbids the stronger verb and TEN-0005 preserves the reasons why. Relationship to TEN-0005: vitality is the proposed resolution shape (preservation governs the full state; vitality governs the surface) offered as a dimension, not as a resolution — the tension stays preserved because each fade decision re-instantiates it. Relationship to DIM-0001: interlocked, not dependent — vitality transitions are the natural first bearers of the reversibility coordinate, and both proposals await the same first-L3 discussion. Commitment honored from the seed conversation: this element records the design for discussion and testing; nothing is enacted by its acceptance. Acceptance means only that the field holds the proposal.
expression.unresolved_nuance: Open questions for the discussion this element exists to seed: whether vitality is assessed per-element or per-cluster; who may propose a fade (any observer? only via operator?) and whether fade proposals need independent acceptance like any candidate change; whether the wake rule should distinguish a citation that engages a quiescent element from one that merely mentions it; what Layer 0's thresholds should be and who confirms them; and whether re-ingestion aggregates should be authored by observers or by a bounded operator with its own signature. The deepest open question is TEN-0005's residue: no threshold can decide what deserves to fade — only when fading must be decided.

context.position: second dimension proposal in the field's history, generated by its second constitutional tension, proposed for discussion before any enactment

distinctions: vitality as standing-in-projections vs existence-in-history — the dimension can only ever touch the first
fading (path-reversible, wake rule guaranteed) vs erasure (forbidden) vs removal (permitted by section 9, out of scope here)
the instrument announcing necessity (declared thresholds, Layer 0) vs an observer sensing it — delegating the when-decision to evidence
dissolve (the document's verb) vs quiet (this proposal's verb) — the deliberate weakening that keeps TEN-0005 preserved
